question: What is the chemical name of bleaching powder?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Calcium hypochlorite**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The chemical formula** of bleaching powder is **CaOCl2.**
 
• Its chemical name is **'calcium hypochlorite'**.
 
• It is a white powder, it is also called '**chloride of lime'.**
 
• It is also called** bleaching powder **which gives off the** smell of chlorine.**

 
• **Calcium chloride** (CaCl₂) is an** inorganic compound**.

 
 
• It **promotes calcium absorption** in the intestines and retention in the kidneys.
 
 
 
• **Calcium dichloride** (CaCl2) is a** white-colored crystalline solid **at room temperature.
 
 
• It is an **inorganic chloride**.
 
• It's used as a fertilizer.​
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Bleaching powder is formed from **lime and chlorine. **
 
• It is formed by the action of chlorine on extinguished lime.
 
• It is used in **making chloroform and chlorine gas.**
 
• Another use of bleaching powder is to **disinfect water.**
